text: Nasir Aslam Wani, born on 31 August 1964, is an Indian politician from the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir and is a member of the National Conference party. He served as the Minister of State for Tourism & Culture, Housing & Urban Development, Public Health Engineering (PHE), Revenue & Relief, and later assumed additional responsibility for the Home Department. Wani won the state assembly elections in 2008 from the Amirakadal Constituency and became a minister in the cabinet headed by Omar Abdullah, being inducted into the Council of Ministers on 11 July 2009 as Minister of State for Housing & Urban Development, PHE, Tourism, and Revenue & Relief. In the 2024 assembly elections, he contested from Kupwara and lost to Fayaz Mir of the PDP, after which he was nominated as Advisor to Chief Minister Omar Abdullah. At Amirakadal, he secured 3922 votes compared to 3103 votes received by his rival Parvez Ahmad of the PDP. Wani is the grandson of the late Ghulam Nabi Wani Sogami, a politician. He has been actively involved with various NGOs for social work and joined the Youth National Conference in 1998, serving as its Central Secretary. He also held the position of Provincial Secretary of Kashmir Province and was a member of the Central Working Committee of the Jammu and Kashmir National Conference. In 2011, he was given an additional charge of the Home Department.
